decision.summary: Landlord only authorised a free warranty service; the provider says the oven is out of warranty and gave conflicting visit dates. I recorded the conditional decision, asked the provider to confirm the date, asked the landlord for a decision on a paid inspection/quote, updated the tenant and set a hold until 23 May.
